# costgraph_aws_integration (Resource)

Connect an existing AWS FOCUS billing export through an IAM read role. Requires an organization owner's user API key with the organization:manage scope. CostGraph verifies real export access before saving settings. AWS IAM, S3, and billing export setup remain outside this resource. Updates preserve the connection UUID. Import uses its UUID and supports assume-role connections only. Destroying the resource disconnects collection and removes the account's billing data from cost views. It also removes any automation access associated with that connection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "costgraph_aws_integration" "production" {
  tenant_id                     = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  billing_account_id            = "123456789012"
  display_name                  = "Production AWS"
  region                        = "us-east-2"
  bucket                        = "example-focus-export"
  prefix                        = "billing/FOCUS/"
  role_arn                      = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/CostGraphRead"
  activate_cost_allocation_tags = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `billing_account_id` (String) Billing account whose export CostGraph reads. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `bucket` (String) Existing S3 bucket containing the FOCUS billing export. This resource does not create the bucket or export.
- `region` (String) AWS region containing the billing export bucket.
- `role_arn` (String) Existing IAM read role that CostGraph assumes. Configure its trust policy with the deployment's trusted principal and your organization's external ID before creating this connection. Access keys are not supported by this resource.
- `tenant_id` (String) Lowercase UUID of the tenant that receives the billing data. Changing it replaces the connection.

### Optional

- `activate_cost_allocation_tags` (Boolean) Allow CostGraph to activate discovered AWS cost allocation tags. Defaults to true. Set false when the read role must not change tag activation.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in CostGraph. Defaults to the billing account identifier. Omitting it after creation preserves the existing name.
- `enable_recommendations` (Boolean) Allow CostGraph to collect the provider's savings recommendations. Defaults to true. The cloud identity needs the corresponding read permissions.
- `prefix` (String) Object prefix containing the billing export. Defaults to an empty prefix when created. Omitting it after creation preserves the existing value. Set an empty string to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `connection_id` (String) Public connection identifier. Use id for import.
- `external_id` (String) Organization external ID stored with the assumed role. Obtain it from CostGraph setup before configuring the role trust policy. This output is available after the connection is created.
- `id` (String) Connection UUID used for management and import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import costgraph_aws_integration.production 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002
```
